IncidentDef.label: Wraith Stargate assault
IncidentDef.letterText: A hostile Wraith hunting party is using the colony's Stargate as an assault corridor. Their objective is biological capture rather than a suicidal stand: a supporting Dart will cull prey while the newly arrived hunters cover the operation, and the survivors will attempt to retreat through this same gate once enough captives are taken or the force is badly degraded. The first hunting party may be followed by another dial while the hunt remains unresolved. Keeping the original gate disabled, hibernating, iris-blocked or destroyed can deny the fast retreat corridor and force surviving Wraith to flee across the map.

IncidentDef.label: Asuran Stargate assault
IncidentDef.letterText: A hostile Asuran force has selected the colony's Stargate as its point of entry. This is a precision strike rather than a mass assault: expect the team to pursue selected technology and attempt to withdraw.

IncidentDef.label: Replicator Stargate incursion
IncidentDef.letterText: The Stargate has opened onto a hostile Replicator-controlled destination. Modular machines are pouring through the active gate. Fresh swarms begin primitive, but surviving units can adapt and recombine. The swarm may attempt up to two follow-on dials while this Stargate remains usable; make the gate unavailable between waves to sever the corridor.

IncidentDef.label: contaminated Stargate salvage
IncidentDef.letterText: Apparently inert modular machine substrate has appeared near the colony's Stargate after off-world traffic. It is not an active Replicator, but its internal lattice may become dangerous if the material is left unsecured.
